payroll.deductionsAreComputedAutomatical: Deductions are computed with the real 2026 tables: Pub 15-T federal withholding from each employee's W-4, FICA (Social Security cap applied), CA/NY state withholding, standing deductions, and booth rent. A legacy flat-% override, when set on a member, replaces the federal figure and is labeled an estimate.

payroll.trackingScopeBody: This app calculates real 2026 withholding (federal Pub 15-T from each employee's W-4, FICA with the Social Security cap applied, CA and NY state tables), tracks every tax liability with its due date, and prepares 941/940/W-2 workpapers. It does not pay employees, does not deposit taxes with any agency, and does not file returns — you remit using the liability schedule, so the amounts and dates are right.
payroll.liabilitiesNote: Every posted run adds its tax obligations here with due dates. Pay each agency yourself (EFTPS / EDD / state portal), then mark the row remitted. This app never moves the money.
payroll.sutaNote: SUTA rates: CA 3.4% and NY 4.1% (new-employer defaults) are built in; other states need a rate set via the API or they show NOT_IMPLEMENTED — never a silent zero.

datacleanLanding.name: DataClean API
datacleanLanding.heroTitle: Messy lists in. Clean records out.
datacleanLanding.heroBody: DataClean is an API that tidies customer, vendor and item lists: phone numbers normalized, dates unified, duplicates flagged with evidence — every change explained, nothing invented.
datacleanLanding.f1Body: Send a CSV or rows and get a mess report, a schema verdict, and the cleaned records — each change carrying its rule and confidence.
datacleanLanding.f2Body: Probabilistic record linkage flags likely duplicates with per-field evidence. Suggestions only — your data is never merged behind your back.
datacleanLanding.f3Body: Dates, phone numbers and addresses normalized one value at a time, in a versioned result shape your code can rely on.
datacleanLanding.f4Body: Unparseable values are preserved, never guessed. Usage is metered per key, and limits answer with plain 429s.
datacleanLanding.s1Body: Issue an API key in the console. It is shown once, stored hashed, and scoped to your workspace only.
datacleanLanding.s2Body: POST a CSV or JSON rows to the cleanup endpoints. Preview first, clean when you're happy.
datacleanLanding.s3Body: Every call is metered — calls, rows, per key and per endpoint — on the console's Usage page.
datacleanLanding.placeholderNote: Placeholder pricing — final prices are not set yet.
datacleanLanding.testModeNote: Checkout is in test mode — nothing is charged.
datacleanLanding.footer: DataClean is part of Mind at Ease Solutions. The demo persists nothing; the API meters usage but this build charges nothing.
